meta.title: AviShifo — CRM for clinics. Try it free for 7 days
meta.description: Multi-branch cloud CRM for private clinics in Uzbekistan: live queue, patient records, cash desk, lab, SMS and Telegram notifications. 7-day free trial.

hero.title: A CRM for your clinic. <hl>Try it free for 7 days</hl>
hero.subtitle: Live queue, patient records, cashier, laboratory and analytics — all in one system. Sign up and run your whole clinic on AviShifo today.

features.title: Everything your clinic needs
features.subtitle: One system for every process — from check-in to payment.

queue.title: Live queue
queue.desc: Real-time queue over WebSocket and a TV screen for the waiting room.

ehr.title: Patient records & EHR
ehr.desc: SOAP structure, ICD-10 diagnoses, prescriptions and full medical history.

appointments.title: Appointments & calendar
appointments.desc: Doctor schedules, online booking and automatic reminders.

cashier.title: Cashier & payments
cashier.desc: Payme, Click, Uzum, cash and terminal; cashier shifts and reconciliation.

lab.title: Laboratory
lab.desc: Test orders, results and automatic flagging of out-of-range values.

notifications.title: SMS & Telegram
notifications.desc: Reminders and notifications via Eskiz.uz SMS and a Telegram bot.

analytics.title: Analytics & reports
analytics.desc: Live reports on revenue, patient flow and doctor performance.

portal.title: Patient portal
portal.desc: Online booking, results and easy patient access to medical history.

highlight.title: Live queue & TV display
highlight.subtitle: A real-time queue that works with zero page refresh. Waiting-room TV screens call patients with a voice announcement.

zeroRefresh.title: Zero refresh
zeroRefresh.desc: The queue updates instantly over WebSocket — no need to reload the page.

tv.title: Waiting-room screen
tv.desc: A fullscreen display with large numbers, room and your clinic branding.

voice.title: Voice announcement
voice.desc: "Patient A-013, please go to room 5" — auto-call in Uzbek and Russian.

priority.title: Priority & transfer
priority.desc: Priority patients, transfer between doctors and re-calling skipped ones.

preview.announce: Patient A-013, please go to room 5

roles.title: A dedicated workspace for every role
roles.subtitle: AviShifo is tailored to every member of your clinic team.

director.title: Director
director.desc: Overall analytics, revenue and multi-branch oversight.

benefits.title: Why AviShifo?
benefits.subtitle: A modern platform built specifically for clinics in Uzbekistan.

security.title: Security & isolation
security.desc: Every clinic's data is fully separated and protected by tenant isolation.

local.title: Built for Uzbekistan
local.desc: Localized for the som (UZS), +998 numbers and the Asia/Tashkent time zone.

fast.title: Fast to launch
fast.desc: A cloud solution — no installation, get started in a few minutes.

multilang.title: Multilingual
multilang.desc: Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian and English — convenient for everyone.

trial.title: How the trial starts
trial.subtitle: Three steps, about five minutes — and your clinic is fully running on AviShifo.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.desc: Enter your clinic name and phone number and confirm the code. No contract needed.

setup.title: Set up your clinic
setup.desc: Branches, doctors and the rest of your staff, services and prices — all entered in one place.

launch.title: Start working
launch.desc: Reception queues the patient, the doctor fills in the record, the cash desk takes payment — from day one.

assurances.fullAccess: Every module unlocked for all 7 days
assurances.ownData: Your data stays yours — export it anytime

finalCta.title: Digitize your clinic
finalCta.subtitle: Get started with AviShifo today — leave paper queues and scattered schedules behind.
finalCta.note: The trial ends on its own

footer.tagline: A modern management platform for private clinics.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits
pricing.subtitle: Sized to your clinic — change anytime
pricing.note: Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. For a large network we prepare an individual offer — get in touch.

starter.name: Starter
starter.tagline: For small clinics and single offices

patient.title: Patient account — your clinic in your pocket
patient.subtitle: If your clinic runs on AviShifo, your lab results and appointments are right there on your phone — no calls, no queueing.

labs.title: Lab results
labs.desc: A result shows up in your account the moment the lab finishes it — no second trip to the clinic.

appointments.title: Appointments and booking
appointments.desc: Book a doctor online, see your slot and get a reminder before it.

documents.title: Documents and receipts
documents.desc: Summaries, prescriptions and payment receipts in one place — download them anytime.

history.title: Medical history
history.desc: Diagnoses and treatment history — unlocked once your clinic approves it.

patient.telegram: All of it is in our Telegram bot too
patient.hint: Sign in with a code sent to your phone — no password needed.
